name: SNU Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)
amount: Full tuition for up to 4 semesters + stipend from KRW 500,000/month (amount and duration vary by college)
dlText: Applied for with the SNU graduate admission each semester; check current round dates (not verified for 2027)

eligibility.note: Non-Korean applicants with non-Korean parents who completed their entire education outside Korea; eligible countries and participating colleges change every semester

fields: Programmes at the designated SNU colleges/schools (vary by semester)
note: You apply for admission and the scholarship in the same online application, and your college selects recipients from the admission documents. Around 20 awards per intake.

name: UNIST Graduate Scholarship (International Admission)
host: UNIST (Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology)
amount: Government/UNIST category: tuition covered + stipend (UNIST category min. KRW 17.28M/year for MS in science & engineering)
dlText: Several admission rounds a year (Spring and Fall); check the current guideline for dates
tags: Not open to applicants still employed elsewhere
fields: Science, engineering, CS/AI (business school uses a separate standard)
note: Funding depends on the category you apply under: Government and UNIST categories cover tuition and pay a stipend, while the 'Other' category is self-funded. Applicants employed elsewhere must use the 'Other' category or resign before classes start.

name: GIST Scholarship (International Graduate Admission)
host: GIST (Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology)
amount: Tuition waiver + monthly allowances, health insurance, one-way flight reimbursement (matriculation fee KRW 680,000 payable)
dlText: Spring and Fall admission rounds; check the current guideline for dates
note: All admitted international graduate students get the GIST scholarship with no separate application. Research projects add assistantship pay, and the competitive Lotte Foundation award adds KRW 900,000/month for top MS applicants.

name: DGIST Graduate Scholarship (International)
host: DGIST (Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology)
amount: Tuition exemption + stipend: Government scholarship min. KRW 9.6M/year (MS); DGIST scholarship min. KRW 15M/year (MS)
dlText: Several admission rounds a year (e.g. 2027 Spring 2nd round ran 27 Aug–10 Sep 2026); check the site for the next round
tags: DGIST scholarship type varies by department
note: Admission puts you on a scholarship automatically, with no separate process. Which type (Government or DGIST) you can get depends on the department, so ask the department or your prospective supervisor.

name: POSTECH Graduate TA/RA Funding (International)
amount: TA/RA package KRW 1,850,000/month for MS (2026), covering tuition and living allowance; advisors may add more
dlText: Several admission rounds a year; check the current admissions guide for dates
tags: POSCO Global Scholarship for designated countries
note: Admitted graduate students are funded through TA/RA packages that include tuition and a living allowance. The POSCO Global Scholarship (full tuition plus monthly allowance) and the Ruth Satter award for Asian women are applied for after admission.

name: Khalifa University Graduate Scholarship for International Students
host: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
amount: Tiered: top tiers full tuition + AED 20,000/month stipend, flights, insurance, textbooks; lower tiers 25–75% tuition and smaller stipends
dlText: Fall 2027 master's applications not yet open (only PhD listed, closing 1 Feb 2027); register interest on the admissions page
note: Scholarship tiers range from full tuition with a large monthly stipend down to partial tuition waivers, so check which tier your offer gives. MSc tuition without a scholarship is about AED 155,000/year.

name: KFUPM Graduate Scholarship (MS, international)
host: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals
amount: No tuition + monthly stipend (by category), free campus housing, medical care, textbooks, air tickets
dlText: 15 Dec 2026 (MS thesis-based window on the apply page; intake not labelled, time not stated)
fields: Engineering, sciences, computing, business (select MS programmes)
note: Full scholarships go to distinguished MS applicants, mainly in thesis-based programmes without a matching PhD track. International master's students are funded as research assistants.

name: HBKU Graduate Scholarship (Master's)
amount: Tuition waiver (75% STEM, 60% SHAPE master's) + QAR 7,000/month stipend for international master's (up to 21 months) + one round-trip flight
dlText: 1 Feb 2027 for international applicants to the College of Humanities and Social Sciences (time not stated); other colleges set their own dates
fields: STEM, humanities, social sciences, law, policy
note: Tuition waivers are standard across HBKU and international master's students can also get a monthly stipend. Stipends depend on available funds and the stipend figures may be dated, so confirm them with HBKU.

name: Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship (50%) – Postgraduate
amount: 50% tuition fee reduction for the standard programme duration
dlText: Considered with your coursework application; check the scholarship page for intake dates

eligibility.note: Commencing international students (not Australian/NZ citizens or permanent residents) in eligible postgraduate coursework programmes

fields: Most postgraduate coursework programmes (some psychology and health degrees excluded)
note: A competitive 50% tuition reduction for high-achieving international coursework students. It does not cover living costs, visas or health cover, and excludes research degrees.

name: Melbourne Research Scholarship (Master by Research)
amount: 100% fee remission + AUD 41,100/year stipend (2027 rate) for up to 2 years
dlText: Set by faculty and round; e.g. Medicine, Dentistry & Health Sciences Round 2 closes 31 Jan 2027 (time not stated)
note: International applicants to a research master's are automatically considered when they apply by their faculty's closing date. Awards go to the highest-ranked applicants on academic results and research potential.

name: GRIPS MEXT Scholarship (University Recommendation, MP1/MP2)
host: National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS)
amount: JPY 147,000/month + application, admission and tuition fees + return economy airfare
dlText: Online registration 20 Nov 2026, documents 27 Nov 2026 (MP1/MP2, applicants outside Japan; time not stated)

eligibility.note: Nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan, under 35 on 1 April 2027; MP1/MP2 are aimed at public officials

note: For the 2027 intake GRIPS offers its MEXT places to master's students only in the MP1 and MP2 public policy programmes. You apply through GRIPS, not the embassy route. These programmes are often aimed at public officials, so check the work-experience requirement on GRIPS's page.
nextText: Next round expected ~Oct–Nov 2027 (estimated from the 2026 cycle)

name: HKUST Postgraduate Studentship (MPhil)
host: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
amount: HK$19,135/month (2026/27) for up to 2 years; tuition scholarships available
dlText: Programme-specific application rounds; check your MPhil programme page
fields: Science, engineering, business, humanities, social sciences
note: Full-time MPhil students admitted with funding get the monthly studentship. The Asian Future Leaders Scholarship pays up to about HK$279,120/year including tuition for young Asian MPhil scholars.

name: HKU Postgraduate Studentship (MPhil)
amount: HK$19,135/month basic rate (from 1 Sep 2025)
dlText: Main round 1 Dec 2026 for most faculties (Law: 15 Nov 2026, 23:59 HKT); time not stated for others
note: Full-time MPhil students can get the Postgraduate Studentship, which is a living stipend. Apply in the main round, since studentships are mostly given then.

name: NUS Research Scholarship (Master's by Research)
amount: Full tuition waiver + S$2,900/month (international master's, rates from 1 Jan 2026), up to 2 years
dlText: Applied for with research admission; deadlines vary by school
note: International research master's scholars get a full tuition waiver and a monthly stipend, but must do teaching or research assistant hours. Some schools (e.g. Public Health) do not fund research master's.

name: Yonsei Global Leader Fellowship (Graduate)
amount: Entrance and tuition fees + stipend, up to 4 semesters (master's)
dlText: Spring and Fall admission rounds; check the graduate school's international scholarship guide
note: Your college recommends you for this fellowship, and it is the most generous Yonsei graduate award. Departments also give full or 50% tuition scholarships (Outstanding International Student Scholarship) one semester at a time.

name: Korea University Graduate School Foreign Student Scholarship
amount: Type A: 100% entrance + tuition fee + living support (4 months); Types B/C: about 60–65% of tuition (first semester, renewable by GPA)
dlText: Reviewed with the admission application each semester; check the current admission guide
note: Admission and scholarship review happen together, and the award tier is set at admission. Later semesters depend on your GPA, and sources are dated, so check the current guide.

name: NTHU International Student Scholarship (Master's)
amount: Tuition and credit fee waiver + NT$5,000/month (full scholarship); tuition-only waiver tier also offered
dlText: Applied for with admission; re-apply every year (check NTHU admission dates)
note: Covers tuition and credit fees with a small monthly stipend for international degree students. The award is yearly, so you must re-apply for your second year.

name: NYCU International Student Scholarship (Graduate)
host: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
amount: Up to NT$33,000/month + tuition waiver for 2 years (amounts adjusted by budget; often NT$7,000–25,000/month)
dlText: Incoming students apply with the admission application
note: Stipend and tuition waiver can be awarded together or separately, and amounts change with the budget. Not open to holders of Taiwan government scholarships.

name: Peking University Scholarship for International Students (Graduate)
amount: Full or partial tuition waiver; top tier adds monthly living stipend + medical insurance (stipend amount not published)
dlText: Usually due in January and March with the online admission application (studyatpku.com); check the 2027 notice
note: This is PKU's own scholarship, separate from the Chinese Government (CSC) awards, and you apply in the same online application. Not every award includes a living stipend.

name: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
amount: NZ$18,204/year stipend + tuition waiver up to NZ$35,000 (thesis component, up to 1 year)
dlText: Apply any time; applications reviewed four times a year

eligibility.note: International students (not NZ citizens/residents) starting their first thesis-based master's

note: Very competitive, with one award per teaching division each year. The waiver covers only the thesis part, so you may pay part of the fees.

name: Tohoku University International Excellence Scholarship
amount: Full or 50% tuition fee
dlText: New from 2027 entry; recipients selected from entrance exam results, no fixed date

eligibility.note: International students in undergraduate, master's or professional degree programmes at Tohoku University

note: Replaces the old need-based tuition exemption from the 2027 academic year. About the top one-third of eligible students in each programme are expected to get it.
